question: In which of the following states Vidhan Sabha elections was not held in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Haryana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Vidhan Sabha elections were not held in Haryana in 2022.**
 
• **Elections were held in Goa, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh in 2022.**
 
• Haryana had its last Vidhan Sabha elections in 2019 and the **next elections are due in 2024.**
 
• Vidhan Sabha elections are conducted **every 5 years in most states of India**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Goa had its Vidhan Sabha **elections in **February 2022,** and the ruling party, BJP, won a majority.
 
• **Punjab had its Vidhan Sabha** elections in February-March 2022, and the AAP party won a majority.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh had its Vidhan Sabha** elections in February-March 2022, and the ruling party, BJP, won a landslide victory. Uttar Pradesh has the largest Vidhan Sabha in India with 403 seats.
 
• Vidhan Sabha elections were also held in Manipur and Uttarakhand in 2022.
